persian.name: خازن

faq.a: Khazan is associated with the Arabic form خازن, whose core sense is treasurer, keeper of treasure.

faq.q: What is the origin of Khazan?
faq.a: Khazan is associated with Arabic. Khazan is Arabic خَازِن (Khāzin) 'treasurer, keeper of treasure', from the root خ ز ن (kh-z-n). The source gloss 'Treasure, Wealth' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
Yes — the underlying form خازن is Arabic.
Khazan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khazan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Khazan mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khazan is rendered خازن and carries the sense خزان، خزانچی.

faq.q: What does Khazan mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khazan is rendered خازن and carries the sense خزانهدار، گنجور.
A romanized syllable approximation is kha-zan. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khazan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khazan, khazan. Script forms are خازن, ख़ाज़न.

faq.q: Is Khazan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
